discovery: http://localhost:5001/.well-known/mfe-manifest.yaml

capabilities:
  - StationConsole:
      type: domain
      description: Render the station console — domain menu, status rail, and the berth strip; selecting a domain drives the control plane

  - Load:
      type: platform
      lifecycle:
        before:
          - onLoadBegin:
              handler: onLoadBegin
              description: Log load lifecycle entry
        after:
          - onLoadComplete:
              handler: onLoadComplete
              description: Log load success and available components
        error:
          - onLoadError:
              handler: onLoadError
              contained: true
              description: Log load failure

  - Render:
      type: platform
      lifecycle:
        before:
          - onRenderBegin:
              handler: onRenderBegin
              description: Log render lifecycle entry
        after:
          - onRenderComplete:
              handler: onRenderComplete
              description: Log render success
        error:
          - onRenderError:
              handler: onRenderError
              contained: true
              description: Log render failure

# The console contributes three regions to the host layout (ADR-058/066-069).
# berth.{id} is a keyed pattern: one address per berth (meridian-console/berth.b1
# … berth.b6), each a desired-state placement target for the docking-control
# BerthTile capability.
providesSlots:
  - id: main
    description: Primary work area — the active domain MFE composes here
  - id: status
    description: Secondary status rail — compact status cards compose here
  - id: berth.{id}
    description: One tile per docking berth on the berth strip, keyed by berth id

# BFF (ADR-012/046): two upstreams with clashing conventions. Harbormaster's
# snake_case is camelCased by the always-on namingConvention transform;
# StellarLedger's {result, meta} envelopes are unwrapped at the graph level
# by hoistField, so consumers see plain lists — the mess stops here.
data:
  sources:
    - name: Harbormaster
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/harbormaster.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
    - name: StellarLedger
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/stellar-ledger.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
      transforms:
        - hoistField:
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [listCharges, result]
              newFieldName: charges
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [listValuations, result]
              newFieldName: valuations
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [listAccounts, result]
              newFieldName: accounts
  mockSwitch:
    enabled: true
  serve:
    endpoint: /graphql
    playground: true

tags: [meridian, docking, ops, angular]
category: operations

endpoint: http://localhost:5002
remoteEntry: http://localhost:5002/remoteEntry.js
discovery: http://localhost:5002/.well-known/mfe-manifest.yaml

capabilities:
  - DockingBoard:
      type: domain
      description: Full berth board — occupancy from Harbormaster joined with outstanding tariff status from StellarLedger

  - BerthTile:
      type: domain
      description: Compact single-berth tile for the console's keyed berth strip (props.berthId selects the berth)

  - TrafficLog:
      type: domain
      description: Recent and scheduled dockings — the station traffic picture

  - Load:
      type: platform
      lifecycle:
        before:
          - onLoadBegin:
              handler: onLoadBegin
              description: Log load lifecycle entry
        after:
          - onLoadComplete:
              handler: onLoadComplete
              description: Log load success and available components
        error:
          - onLoadError:
              handler: onLoadError
              contained: true
              description: Log load failure

  - Render:
      type: platform
      lifecycle:
        before:
          - onRenderBegin:
              handler: onRenderBegin
              description: Log render lifecycle entry
        after:
          - onRenderComplete:
              handler: onRenderComplete
              description: Log render success
        error:
          - onRenderError:
              handler: onRenderError
              contained: true
              description: Log render failure

# BFF (ADR-012/046): two upstreams with clashing conventions. Harbormaster's
# snake_case is camelCased by the always-on namingConvention transform;
# StellarLedger's {result, meta} envelopes are unwrapped at the graph level
# by hoistField, so consumers see plain lists — the mess stops here.
data:
  sources:
    - name: Harbormaster
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/harbormaster.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
    - name: StellarLedger
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/stellar-ledger.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
      transforms:
        - hoistField:
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [listCharges, result]
              newFieldName: charges
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [listValuations, result]
              newFieldName: valuations
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [listAccounts, result]
              newFieldName: accounts
  mockSwitch:
    enabled: true
  serve:
    endpoint: /graphql
    playground: true

dependencies:
  runtime:
    "@angular/core": ^19.2.16
    "@angular/common": ^19.2.16
    "@angular/platform-browser": ^19.2.16
    rxjs: ^7.8.0
    zone.js: ~0.14.0

# THREE-source BFF — the maximal mess: PascalCase pages (StationOS),
# camelCase cursor envelopes (StellarLedger), bare snake_case arrays
# (Harbormaster), all normalized onto one graph. Vendor identity is the
# cross-system pun: VendorId 105 <-> merchantId "ACC-7105".
data:
  sources:
    - name: StationOS
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/station-os.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
      transforms:
        - hoistField:
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [GetVendors, Data]
              newFieldName: vendors
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [GetStalls, Data]
              newFieldName: stalls
    - name: StellarLedger
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/stellar-ledger.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
      transforms:
        - hoistField:
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [listSettlements, result]
              newFieldName: settlements
    - name: Harbormaster
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/harbormaster.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
  mockSwitch:
    enabled: true
  serve:
    endpoint: /graphql
    playground: true

# Two-source BFF: the cargo manifest is ONE logical document split across
# two systems by organizational accident — header lines in the harbormaster
# (customs), valuations in the ledger (finance). hoistField unwraps the
# ledger envelope; the join key is the finance team's invented composite
# ref DCK-004021/7.
data:
  sources:
    - name: Harbormaster
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/harbormaster.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
    - name: StellarLedger
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/stellar-ledger.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
      transforms:
        - hoistField:
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [listValuations, result]
              newFieldName: valuations
  mockSwitch:
    enabled: true
  serve:
    endpoint: /graphql
    playground: true

# Single-source BFF — the deliberate contrast case: StationOS only.
# The {Data, Pagination} envelope unwraps at the graph via hoistField,
# PascalCase fields camelCase via the always-on namingConvention transform.
data:
  sources:
    - name: StationOS
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/station-os.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
      transforms:
        - hoistField:
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [GetTelemetry, Data]
              newFieldName: telemetry
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [GetModules, Data]
              newFieldName: modules
  mockSwitch:
    enabled: true
  serve:
    endpoint: /graphql
    playground: true

dependencies:
  runtime:
    "@angular/core": ^19.2.16
    "@angular/common": ^19.2.16

# THREE-source BFF — the maximal mess: PascalCase pages (StationOS),
# camelCase cursor envelopes (StellarLedger), bare snake_case arrays
# (Harbormaster), all normalized onto one graph. Vendor identity is the
# cross-system pun: VendorId 105 <-> merchantId "ACC-7105".
data:
  sources:
    - name: StationOS
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/station-os.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
      transforms:
        - hoistField:
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [GetVendors, Data]
              newFieldName: vendors
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [GetStalls, Data]
              newFieldName: stalls
    - name: StellarLedger
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/stellar-ledger.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
      transforms:
        - hoistField:
            - typeName: Query
              pathConfig: [listSettlements, result]
              newFieldName: settlements
    - name: Harbormaster
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/harbormaster.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
  mockSwitch:
    enabled: true
  serve:
    endpoint: /graphql
    playground: true

data:
  sources:
    - name: Harbormaster
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/harbormaster.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
    - name: StationOS
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/station-os.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: 'Bearer {context.jwt}'
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
  mockSwitch:
    enabled: true
  serve:
    endpoint: /graphql
    playground: true
